findings.title: Removing diffPaired drops the replace-vs-nested size check the design requires
findings.why: openspec/changes/archive/2026-11-20-add-create-patch/design.md (Replace vs recurse, and the Risks line) says paired gap items use `replace` when the nested diff is not smaller than one `replace`, so unrelated items don't produce many ops. Now diffValues is called directly. Two unrelated objects or arrays at the same gap position, such as `[{a:1,b:2,c:3}]` to `[{d:4,e:5,f:6}]`, become several remove and add ops instead of one `replace`. The patch is larger than before and the documented behaviour no longer holds. Either restore the check or update the design doc to say nested diffing is now unconditional.
